headline: Foundation's $200K Gift Erases $30M in Medical Debt
meta_description: A single $200,000 donation from the Arconic Foundation wiped out nearly $30 million in medical debt for over 26,000 people across five states.
summary_short: The Arconic Foundation's $200,000 donation eliminated $30 million in medical debt affecting 26,000+ people in five states through Undue Medical Debt's model.
body:
A $200,000 donation from the Arconic Foundation has wiped out nearly $30 million in medical debt for more than 26,000 people across five states. The relief was made possible through Undue Medical Debt's penny-on-the-dollar model, which allows charitable organizations to purchase medical debt at a fraction of its face value and then forgive it entirely.

This approach transforms a modest charitable contribution into life-changing aid for thousands of families struggling under the weight of healthcare costs. Rather than requiring recipients to apply or jump through bureaucratic hoops, Undue Medical Debt's model identifies and releases people from their obligations automatically.

The impact extends across multiple states, reaching individuals who likely had no idea their debt was about to vanish—a quiet but profound form of relief that addresses one of America's most persistent financial burdens for ordinary households.
quick_facts: Nearly $30 million in medical debt eliminated
